an4.195:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme.
an4.195:1.2: Atha kho Vappo Sakko nigaṇṭhasāvako yen' āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ abhivādetvā . . . pe . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Vappaṃ Sakkaṃ nigaṇṭhasāvakaṃ āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno etad avoca :
an4.195:2.1: Idh' assa Vappa kāyena saṃvuto vācāya saṃvuto manasā saṃvuto avijjāvirāgā vijjuppādā
an4.195:2.2: passasi no tvaṃ Vappa taṃ ṭhānaṃ yatonidānaṃ purisaṃ dukkhavedaniyā āsavā assaveyyum abhisamparāyan ti?
an4.195:2.4: idh' assa bhante pubbe pāpakammaṃ kataṃ avipakkavipākaṃ
an4.195:2.5: tatonidānaṃ purisaṃ dukkhavedaniyā āsavā assaveyyuṃ abhisamparāyan ti.
an4.195:2.6: Ayañ c' eva kho pana āyasmato Mahāmoggallānassa Vappena Sakkena nigaṇṭhasāvakena saddhiṃ kathā vippakatā hoti. 2.
an4.195:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayena paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yen' upaṭṭhānasālā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. Nisajja kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ etad avoca :
an4.195:4.1: Kāya nu 'ttha Moggallāna etarahi kathāya sannisinnā, kā ca pana vo antarā kathā vippakatā ti?
an4.195:4.2: Idhāhaṃ bhante Vappaṃ Sakkaṃ nigaṇṭhasāvakaṃ etad avoca :
an4.195:4.3: idh' assa Vappa kāyena saṃvuto . . . manasā saṃvuto avijjāvirāgā vijjuppādā
an4.195:4.4: passasi no tvaṃ Vappa taṃ ṭhānaṃ yatonidānaṃ purisaṃ dukkhavedaniyā āsavā assaveyyuṃ abhisamparāyan ti.
an4.195:4.5: Evaṃ vutte bhante Vappo Sakko nigaṇṭhasāvako maṃ etad avoca :
an4.195:4.7: idh' assa bhante pubbe pāpakammaṃ kataṃ avipakkavipākaṃ
an4.195:4.8: tatonidānaṃ purisaṃ dukkhavedaniyā āsavā assaveyyuṃ abhisamparāyan
an4.195:4.9: ti--ayaṃ kho no bhante Vappena Sakkena nigaṇṭhasāvakena saddhiṃ kathā vippakatā atha Bhagavā anuppatto ti. 3.
an4.195:5.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Vappaṃ Sakkaṃ nigaṇṭhasāvakaṃ etad avoca :
an4.195:5.2: Sace kho me tvaṃ Vappa anuññeyyañ c' eva anujāneyyāsi paṭikkositabbañ ca paṭikkoseyyāsi yassa ca me bhāsitassa atthaṃ na jāneyyāsi, mam eva tattha uttariṃ paṭipuccheyyāsi--idaṃ
an4.195:5.3: bhante kathaṃ imassa ko attho ti? Siyā no ettha kathāsallāpo ti.
an4.195:5.4: Anuññeyyañ c' evāhaṃ bhante Bhagavato anujānissāmi paṭikkositabbañ ca paṭikkosissāmi, yassa cāhaṃ Bhagavato bhāsitassa atthaṃ na jānissāmi, Bhagavantaṃ yev' ettha uttariṃ paṭipucchissāmi--idam
an4.195:5.5: bhante kathaṃ imassa ko attho ti?
an4.195:6.2: Ye kāyasamārambhapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātapariḷāhā kāyasamārambhā paṭiviratassa evaṃ sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti,
an4.195:6.3: so navañ ca kammaṃ na karoti purāṇaṃ kammaṃ phussa phussa vyantikaroti, sandiṭṭhikā nijjarā akālikā ehipassikā opanayikā paccattaṃ veditabbā viññūhīti.
an4.195:6.4: Passasi no tvaṃ Vappa taṃ ṭhānaṃ yatonidānaṃ purisaṃ dukkhavedaniyā āsavā assaveyyuṃ abhisampārayan ti?
an4.195:7.2: Ye vacīsamārambhapāccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātapariḷāhā vacīsamārambhā paṭiviratassa evaṃ sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti,
an4.195:7.3: so navañ ca kammaṃ . . . phussa phussa vyantikaroti
an4.195:7.5: Passasi no tvaṃ Vappa taṃ ṭhānaṃ yatonidānaṃ purisaṃ dukkhavedaniyā āsavā assaveyyuṃ abhisamparāyan ti?
an4.195:8.2: Ye manosamārambhapaccayā . . . pe . . . manosamārambhā paṭiviratassa evaṃ sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti,
an4.195:9.2: Ye avijjāpaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātapariḷāhā avijjāvirāgā vijjuppādā evaṃ sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti,
an4.195:10.1: Evaṃ sammāvimutticittassa kho Vappa bhikkhuno cha satatavihārā adhigatā honti.
an4.195:10.2: So cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā n' eva sumano hoti na dummano, upekhako viharati sato sampajāno,
an4.195:10.7: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya n' eva sumano hoti na dummano, upekhako viharati sato sampajāno.
an4.195:10.8: So kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti, jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti,
an4.195:10.9: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idh' eva sabba vedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītibhavissantīti pajānāti. 9.
an4.195:11.1: Seyyathāpi Vappa thūṇaṃ paṭicca chāyā paññāyati,
an4.195:11.5: palikhaṇetvā mūlāni uddhareyya antamaso usīranālimattāni pi.
an4.195:11.12: masiṃ katvā mahāvāte vā opuneyya nadiyā vā sīghasotāya pavāheyya.
an4.195:11.13: Evaṃ hi 'ssa Vappa yā thūṇaṃ paṭicca chāyā sā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
an4.195:12.1: Evaṃ eva kho Vappa evaṃ sammāvimutticittassa bhikkhuno cha satatavihārā adhigatā honti.
an4.195:12.7: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya n' eva sumano hoti na dummano, upekhako viharati sato sampajāno.
an4.195:13.1: Evaṃ vutte Vappo Sakko nigaṇṭhasāvako Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca :
an4.195:13.2: Seyyathāpi bhante puriso udayatthiko assa paṇīyaṃ poseyya
an4.195:13.3: so udayañ c' eva na labheyya uttariñ ca kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assa.
an4.195:13.4: Evam eva kho ahaṃ bhante udayatthiko bāle niganthe payirupāsiṃ,
an4.195:13.5: svāhaṃ udayañ c' eva nādhigacchiṃ uttariñ ca kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī ahosiṃ.
an4.195:13.6: Esāhaṃ bhante ajjatagge yo me bālesu nigaṇṭhesu sampasādo taṃ mahāvāte vā opunāmi nadiyā vā sīghasotāya pavāhemi.
an4.195:13.7: Abhikkantaṃ bhante . . . pe . . . Upāsakaṃ maṃ bhante Bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan
